## Type of change

<!-- Keep the ones that apply. -->

- New page(s)

## Checklist

- [ ] Pages start from the matching template in `templates/` and follow `STYLE_GUIDE.md`
- [ ] New pages are placed per the folder conventions and ordered in the section's `.pages` file (or intentionally left to alphabetical order)
- [ ] Internal links are relative paths to `.md` files
- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes locally
- [ ] Diagrams are Mermaid, or exported images with editable sources committed under `assets/`
